title: Hypnos covariate-equation record
description: One named, citation-backed auxiliary body-size/composition equation a model is derived with (lean body mass, fat-free mass, body-surface area, ...). The unit of curation for the v0.7 covariate sublayer. Equations are SHARED across models (many models use James), so they are curated once, exactly like dataset/citations/.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by a model's covariate_model.derived_inputs[].equation.

quantity.description: The derived body-size/composition quantity this equation computes.

form.description: Human-readable, verbatim form (machine-parseable where single-branch; sex branches in sex_specific).

sex_specific.description: Sex-branched verbatim forms when the equation has sex-specific coefficients (Trap 3).

inputs.description: The input covariate variables the equation consumes (e.g. weight, height_cm, age, sex).

units.description: Explicit unit per input variable and the result — height cm-vs-m flips the (W/H)^2 term by 10^4 (Trap 2).

validity_envelope.description: The equation's OWN derivation range; outside it the equation may misbehave INDEPENDENTLY of the disposition envelope (Trap 4). Evaluating outside it tiers the covariate layer (hence the composed simulation) down to D.
